decisions.reason: The glass flake system still only gets a mention on the website and its value in corrosion-protection markets remains uncertain, but it shares two-component technology with the core range and costs little to keep, so the option stays open for another year.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the core repair and injection offer and has its own page, so it signals commitment and costs little to maintain, and nothing yet shows its value will fail to materialize.

The multi-model transfer pump line uses existing pump know-how and in-house manufacturing at low carrying cost, and with prospects still unresolved, keeping the option is worth more than abandoning it.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the established two-component spraying business, the hydraulic system has too little evidence to justify abandonment, and keeping it is cheap.
